tutorials.title: How SpecWithCode works
tutorials.summary: Your subscriptions live on your machines. SpecWithCode connects them over Tailscale, watches every limit, and lets one coordinator per project start threads that open their own pull requests. Auto-resolve closes a thread only once it is merged, green and approved.

chapters.title: More AI than you can use

tutorials.note: Recorded on SpecWithCode 1.0.5 with the author's real EasyChamp project, 12 October 2026, through a read-only session; the thread pane is sped up 1.6x and hostnames are masked. The b-roll is AI-generated, the diagrams are animated, and the narration is AI in the author's cloned voice.
